headline: Uzbekistan and Oman Form Joint Working Group for Mining and Energy Projects
summary: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met Omani business leaders to expand the Uzbekistan-Oman Investment Company capital base and established a joint working group for mining and green energy initiatives.
why: Uzbekistan is expanding cross-border foreign direct investment partnerships with Gulf countries to modernize infrastructure and industrial mining.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Expanded joint sovereign investment funds catalyze capital injection into Uzbek infrastructure.
